name: spytial-core-spec-language
description: Where to find the Spytial spec-language contract. Prefer the machine-readable artifacts over the prose reference when generating specs — they are versioned and tested against the engine parser.

manifest.description: Every constraint and directive, its fields, requiredness, legal values, engine defaults, and deprecations with their rewrites.

json_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for validating a spec document. Stricter than the parser, which ignores what it does not recognize.

prose_reference.description: Human-readable reference with examples and rationale.

versioning.note: The spec language is versioned independently of the spytial-core package. Read `languageVersion` from the manifest and key code generation off that; `spytialCoreVersion` records which release produced the artifact.
